meta.notes: GPT-Pro-confirmed JG/PSE-layer plain-English names/definitions (26). FAIR vars live in the base dict.

JCHJH.description: Coefficient on the twice-lagged change in JHPOP (worker-hours per capita) in the JGCHLDU1 childcare take-up recursion.

JCHYP.description: Coefficient on the lagged change in YPOP (output per capita, Y/pop) in the JGCHLDU1 childcare take-up recursion.

JGBENF.description: Dollar value of the health/non-vacation side of JG benefits = JGHEALTH*JGBEN*JGW*JGJ*JGH, where JGHEALTH=1-JGVAC; a bucket split, not literally 'firm-paid'.

JGBENH.description: Dollar value of the household/vacation side of JG benefits = JGVAC*JGBEN*JGW*JGJ*JGH (B2017$); a benefit-bucket allocation, not 'household-paid'.

JGCHILD.description: JG entrants from the childcare/caregiver channel = JGSWITCH*JGCHLDU1*U(-1), where U = unemployment (L1+L2+L3-E), in millions. (NOT lagged child population.)

JGCHLDU1.description: Recursive take-up rate for the childcare channel, updated by lagged changes in unemployment, JHPOP and YPOP, then applied to U(-1) to form JGCHILD.

JGPTJ1.description: Recursive per-private-firm-job take-up rate for the part-time pool (updated by changes in UR, YPOP, JHPOP), multiplied by JF(-1) to form JGPT.

JGSWITCH.description: Master on/off switch for the JGSWITCH-gated JG entrant/hours identities; setting it 0 zeroes those JG flow terms but does NOT make the full PSE deck identical to stock FAIR (inflation, government accounting and some demand/import channels still differ).

JGU.description: JG hires from unemployment = JGPHASE*(JGHILO*JGULLOT + (1-JGHILO)*JGUUWKS): a high/low BRANCH SELECTION via JGHILO, not an additive sum of both pools.

JGULLL1.description: Recursive per-labor-force take-up rate for the high-branch unemployed pool (updated by change in UR and lagged change in JHPOP); feeds JGULLOT. (Exact 'UULOL'/long-duration label unconfirmed.)

JGULLOT.description: Potential JG entrants from the high-branch unemployed pool = JGSWITCH*JGULLL1*LFORCE(-1); feeds JGU when JGHILO=1.

JGUUWKL1.description: Recursive per-labor-force take-up rate for the short-duration unemployed pool (updated by change in UR and lagged change in JHPOP); feeds JGUUWKS.

JGVAC.description: Share of JG benefits allocated to the household/vacation side; complement JGHEALTH=1-JGVAC is the health side (used in JGBENF). Not a 'health benefit household share'.

JGWAJHIL.description: Estimated high-branch per-labor-force want-a-job entry rate, driven by lagged LFPOP, YPOP and JHPOP; multiplied by LFORCE to form JGWAJHI.

JGWAJLOL.description: Estimated low-branch per-labor-force want-a-job entry rate, driven by lagged LFPOP, YPOP and JHPOP; multiplied by LFORCE to form JGWAJLO.

JGWFADJ.description: Proportional adjustment to the firm wage WF = JGPHASE*JGWFPASS*(JGW*(1+JGBEN)-MINWAGE*(1+MWBEN*MWBCOST)); can be POSITIVE OR NEGATIVE (not a one-sided markup); zero when JGPHASE=0.

JHIJH.description: Coefficient on lagged JHPOP (worker-hours per capita) in the high want-a-job/would-accept equation JGWAJHIL.

JHIYP.description: Coefficient on lagged YPOP (output per capita) in the high would-accept equation JGWAJHIL.

JHPOP.description: PSE employment-intensity driver = firm + federal-civilian + state/local worker-hours over population: (JF*HF+JG*HG+JS*HS)/(POP1+POP2+POP3). NOT jobs/employment per capita; military hours excluded.

JLOJH.description: Coefficient on lagged JHPOP (worker-hours per capita) in the low want-a-job/would-accept equation JGWAJLOL.

JLOYP.description: Coefficient on lagged YPOP (output per capita) in the low would-accept equation JGWAJLOL.

JPTJD.description: Coefficient on the lagged change in JHPOP (worker-hours per capita) in the JGPTJ1 part-time take-up recursion.

JPTYD.description: Coefficient on the lagged change in YPOP (output per capita) in the JGPTJ1 part-time take-up recursion.

JULJH.description: Coefficient on the twice-lagged change in JHPOP in the JGULLL1 high-branch unemployed-pool recursion.

JULUR.description: Coefficient on the change in the unemployment rate (UR-UR(-1)) in the JGULLL1 high-branch unemployed-pool recursion. (Exact 'long-duration' label unconfirmed.)

JUWJH.description: Coefficient on the twice-lagged change in JHPOP in the JGUUWKL1 short-duration unemployed-pool recursion.

LFORCE.description: Total labor force L1+L2+L3, used to scale want-a-job and unemployed-pool JG take-up rates into entrant counts (JGWAJHI/JGWAJLO/JGULLOT/JGUUWKS).

LFPOP.description: Aggregate labor-force participation rate (L1+L2+L3)/(POP1+POP2+POP3), a driver in the high/low want-a-job take-up equations.

MINWAGE.description: National effective minimum wage (the economy-wide effective wage floor), in the same scaled units as the job-guarantee wage JGW; used in the JG wage-floor adjustment (JGWFADJ) as the comparison wage.
